A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AdaSSL research and contain 37 readable pages, including all figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D. The material supports a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original numerical simulations, representation-learning experiments on 3DIdent and CelebA, stochastic Moving-MNIST evaluations, and appendix experiments on iNat-1M.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, robustness tests, and trajectory-retrieval experiments.

M1.justification: AdaSSL-V and AdaSSL-S retain their objectives, architectures, latent-variable inference, and editing functions. Introducing r later in the exposition and expanding the additional-view explanation do not change the procedures already documented in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same numerical-data scenarios, 3DIdent, CelebA, stochastic Moving-MNIST, and iNat-1M. Distribution shifts, noisy pairings, and video settings A and B are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding experiments in Tables 1–7, including InfoNCE, AnInfoNCE, H-InfoNCE, LieSSL, the VAE baselines, and BYOL variants.

E3.justification: Appendix D.3 changes standard-pair 3DIdent augmentation from the same strong augmentations as CelebA to that set excluding Solarization. This revises an explicitly stated protocol; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The editing-function, additional-view, latent-dimension, and regularization analyses are retained, along with noisy-pairing robustness and trajectory/density/retrieval analyses. Expanded explanations and appendix references introduce no new analytical evidence.

E5.justification: Section 4.1 changes reporting over 'at least three random seeds' to 'three random seeds.' This makes the reported run count more specific without establishing a change in runs performed. Mean/standard-deviation reporting remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 retain the same numerical entries, uncertainty values, and comparator rankings. Quantitative plots and qualitative retrieval examples also match. The revised augmentation description is not accompanied by revised scores.

T1.justification: Equation 1 is presented in marginal form, with the existing latent-variable factorization introduced instead in Section 3.1. This is an equivalent reformulation. Proposition 2.1, the objective derivations, and the proofs in Appendices A–B remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same central claims about conditional uncertainty, the two AdaSSL variants, and empirical advantages. Terminology refinements do not substantively change these claims.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 expands the disentanglement hypothesis: v1 appeals to factorized Gaussians, whereas v2 explains how aligning r with independent latent differences can factorize the aggregated posterior and lower its KL divergence to the prior. The stated limitations remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: The first-page footnote and reproducibility statement change from promising a future code release to stating that code is available. Appendix D.3 also revises the augmentation specification. Architecture, hyperparameter, hardware, and runtime details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive comparisons with prior research are retained. Replacing 'weakly-supervised' with 'multiview' CRL and explaining those labels in Appendix D.3 clarify terminology without materially repositioning the contribution.

P1.justification: v2 renames Section 2 and Section 2.1, moves the introduction of r into the method exposition, expands selected explanations, and corrects grammar and cross-references. These are localized revisions within the retained document structure.

P2.justification: Figures and tables retain their content and design, but text reflow produces modest placement and spacing changes, including Table 2 on page 9 and Table 7 on page 28. No display is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies the role of the auxiliary latent variable, strengthens the explanation of disentanglement, and makes reproducibility reporting more specific through the seed count, augmentation specification, and reported code availability. These are useful, limited improvements; the methods, proofs, and empirical evidence are unchanged.
